bullets.text: An elderly officer named Rajagopalan approached Minister R. Kumar in Chennai to air grievances during heavy rain in Velachery and faced shocks from TVK cadres.
Minister Dr. Kumar.ra took swift action to clear stagnant rain water in Velachery, bringing notable relief after heavy downpours.
Torrential overnight rain of 36 cm lashed Chennai, causing severe distress because river mouths were not dredged properly.
The National Disaster Response Force deployed boats and life-saving equipment in Velachery to handle waterlogging in low-lying areas.
Heavy rain caused prolonged power outages exceeding eight hours in Thiruverkadu, causing extreme hardship for local residents.
Heavy rain uprooted trees in over 10 places across Chennai, prompting joint clearance work by city police, fire personnel and corporation workers.
Motorists faced severe difficulties near the TNPDCL Substation office in Velachery because a dug-up main road for laying high-tension cables remained unrepaired.
A fallen giant tree snapped a power pole in Shanmuga Nagar, Thiruverkadu, causing an eight-hour power outage before electricity staff restored lines.
Heavy rainfall boosted combined storage across Chennai's five principal drinking water reservoirs by 237 mcft over two days.
The Avadi cybercrime wing arrested a Delhi man in connection with a boss scam involving 1.90 crore rupees transferred from an Ambattur firm.
A US-based techie from Tamil Nadu was arrested at an airport for using AI to send 1,500 hoax bomb threats across India over several years.
The central government instructed Meta to adjust recommendation systems so users are not disproportionately exposed to a single set of narratives.
Chief Minister Vijay took to the field as heavy rains threatened Chennai, prompting news coverage and public scrutiny of government action.
Media reports highlighted that minister-in-charge officials were absent during heavy overnight rainfall in Chennai while citizens sought updates.
The DMK IT wing questioned the background of TVK functionary Poobalan regarding international drug trafficking amid rising drug availability.
Anbumani urged Chief Minister Vijay to officially notify the Pallikaranai marshland and include Chennai in the Ramsar Wetland Cities list.

stories.snippet: பள்ளிக்கரணையை அறிவிக்கை செய்க; சென்னையை ராம்சார் நகரமாக்குக: முதலமைச்சர் விஜய்க்கு அன்புமணி கடிதம்! பள்ளிக்கரணை சதுப்பு நிலத்தை அறிவிக்கை செய்ய வேண்டும்: சென்னையை ராம்சார் சதுப்புநில மாநகரங்கள் பட்டியலில் சேர்க்க…
